# `gno.land/r/moul/demo/cshijack/v1`

A small proof-of-concept realm built to **demonstrate a realm-hijacking
vulnerability**. It targeted the GopherCon 2024 raffle realm
(`gno.land/r/gc24/raffle`) to show how a caller could hijack / abuse that realm's
behavior — a security-demonstration exercise, never intended for real use.

> ⚠️ **Archived — does not build on current gno master.** The `r/gc24/raffle`
> realm it exploited no longer exists upstream, so this package is marked
> `ignore = true` and kept purely for reference / educational purposes.
